description: Four drum sample players with a decay envelope and a tuning input on each

params.text: Sets that slot's playback level, 0 to 100%, or its accented level instead when 'Level knob controls Accent' is ticked
Sets how long that slot's sample takes to fade away, 1ms to 10 seconds; fully clockwise there is no decay envelope at all
Tunes that slot's sample up or down two octaves, in semitones
Switches choking on between that slot and the next, so a trigger here stops the next slot with a 1ms fade
Plays that slot's sample backwards, from its end towards its start

inputs.text: A trigger here plays that slot's sample from the beginning
Held above 1V as that slot's TRG fires, the accented level is used for that hit
Lengthens that slot's decay by one second per volt, added to its DEC knob
Raises that slot's playback pitch one octave per volt, multiplying whatever its TUNE knob sets

outputs.text: That slot's sample at the level and pitch set, plus any slot above it whose own output has no cable in it

notes: nothing plays until a sample is loaded: right-click the panel and pick a slot under Slots, or right-click a slot's own display area.
slots 1 and 3 carry a CHK switch and slots 2 and 4 carry a REV switch, so choking and reverse are not available on the same slot.
menu: Level knob controls Accent — makes the LVL knobs set the accented level rather than the standard one
Logarithmic Decay — uses a logarithmic decay curve instead of an exponential one
Clear ALL slots — empties all four slots
Select Samples Root — picks a folder, after which a Samples Browser submenu appears in each slot's own right-click menu
Interpolation: None, Linear 1, Linear 2, Hermite — chooses how samples are read between points, which matters when the file's sample rate differs from Rack's or the speed is not 100%
Anti-aliasing filter — adds two-times oversampling and a 20kHz lowpass before the output
Outs mode: Normalled, Solo, Unconnected on out #4 — chooses how a slot with no cable in its own output is handled: added to the next output, dropped, or added to output 4
Store Sample in Patch — saves the loaded samples inside the patch file, which can make it very large
Tips — a submenu that only prints a reminder that the decay knob fully clockwise turns the decay off
